# Requirements Quality Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency and measurability of the approved specification as a whole.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every FR and NFR carry a provenance class (C, D, A, C (HD), PVT) and a source citation? [Completeness, Spec §Source and Classification Conventions] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are functional and non-functional requirements kept in separate tables with distinct ID prefixes, so each requirement is unambiguously one or the other? [Consistency, CON I] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Does each user story US-1 to US-5 include at least one negative acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Does each required scenario SCN-A/B/C list at least one negative or failure acceptance criterion and its required evidence IDs? [Coverage, Spec §SCN-A, §SCN-B, §SCN-C] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is every deferred question DQ-001 to DQ-010 either resolved with a recorded decider and date, or listed with an owner and decision point? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is there a requirement that every confirmed and derived requirement links to at least one test and one evidence or documentation item? [Traceability, Spec §SC-007] [D26] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Does the Glossary definition of "personal data" enumerate data categories precisely enough to decide whether any given stored field qualifies? [Clarity, Spec §Glossary (CR-003), §FR-SHR-012, §A-005] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the Glossary definition of "fails materially" give a per-check rule a reviewer can apply to decide which check failures open the clarification gate? [Clarity, Spec §Glossary (CR-003), §FR-ORC-004] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the Glossary definition of "same stage sequence" under parallelism (same stage executions and same committed audit order) state the comparison precisely, including what is excepted? [Clarity, Spec §Glossary (CR-003), §NFR-DET-001; ADR-003] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "correct, non-corrupted" (FR-SHR-014) defined for creation and for analytics, including the analytics-write-failure case ruled at Human Gate 4? [Clarity, Spec §FR-SHR-014, §A-013; ADR-019] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is every numeric target either an approved PVT or traced to a source, with PVT-001/002 explicitly non-gating? [Measurability, Spec §Proposed Validation Targets; DQ-009] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Is the amended SC-002 (each scenario produces the evidence items assigned to it) consistent with the Required Evidence table and with each scenario's "Required evidence" line? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002 (CR-003), §Required Evidence] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is `SAFE_STOPPED` defined once and consistently, given it is listed as a terminal outcome (FR-ORC-023) and is also resumable (FR-ORC-019)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-ORC-019, §FR-ORC-023] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the outcome descriptions in US-3 AC2 and US-4 consistent with the confirmed interpretation that a release "not ready" ends `FAILED` while approval-gate "reject and terminate" ends `ABORTED`? [Consistency, Spec §US-3, §US-4, §FR-GOV-015; Plan §5.3; ADR-016] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Are plan-level additions absent from the spec (PD-001 private-address rejection, PD-008 daily aggregates, the change-set dependency rule) recorded as approved plan decisions, not presented as spec requirements? [Traceability, Plan §15; ADR-006] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Do the Edge Cases give an expected outcome for every safe-stop trigger listed in FR-ORC-018? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-ORC-018] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the accepted risk of unauthenticated redirect volume stated together with its backlog item (BL-13), so that the creation-only scope of FR-SHR-017 is deliberate rather than an omission? [Assumption, Spec §NFR-SEC-003 (CR-003), §FR-SHR-017; CON V] [Mandatory]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 Is the network dependency of the vulnerability advisory source stated as an assumption with its failure behavior? [Assumption, Plan §6.1; Human Gate 4 ruling 5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Is each exclusion EXC-001 to EXC-006 marked as either a disclosed limitation or out of scope without disclosure? [Clarity, Spec §Exclusions] [Optional]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
